author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.17.0 — Fixes status/charging disagreement at the end of a run: status (from a separately-polled, unverified-mapping code) has been observed live saying 'Cleaning' while charging:true and mode:Idle plainly show the vacuum is docked. Since a vacuum can't be charging and cleaning simultaneously, charging:true now always overrides a conflicting Cleaning status before it's used for anything -- the displayed status attribute, notifications, room-completion crediting, sweep continuation, and poll-interval switching. This was silently blocking sweep continuation (switch stayed 'on' but nothing advanced to the next room) whenever it occurred.
